name: Agent: Creative Direction
summary: Reads the brief like a creative director, then writes the copy — for any brand, any market, never translated word for word.
objectives: Turn a guided interview into channel-ready copy — for any brand, any market — instead of a blank page.
Stop a copy claim that can't be backed before it ships — a check that fails closed, not one that hopes someone notices.
Re-create copy for each market so it reads native, never translate it word for word.
Give an opinion before writing: question the brief, recommend the channel mix, and say what each version is betting on.

outcomes.text: Anyone can download the agent and run it: a guided interview becomes copy for organic social, ads, email, landing pages and video scripts.
Copy with a claim that can't be backed does not ship. The claims check fails closed — an unverified stat or promise holds the copy until a person validates it.
It never translates word for word. Copy is rebuilt for each market so it reads native — Latin America, Spain, Brazil, Turkey — with a person approving the adaptation.
It runs for any brand, not one. The published agent carries no client's private setup — the brand's own configuration lives apart, so the same agent serves whoever loads it.
It proved itself end to end before going live: a full dry run across every channel passed, and campaign copy now routes to it.
It leads with strategy, not just wording: it questions the brief, builds the campaign idea, and states what each version is betting on — so a reviewer can judge the bet, not only the sentence.
It knows the writing rules of 16 channels — from WhatsApp templates to search ads to TV scripts — and refuses to guess at a platform it has no rules for.

The guesses are gone. The marketing team supplied what each channel is actually measured by, across nineteen of them — and the five still awaiting real figures are marked as provisional, so nobody can mistake a placeholder for a decision again.

Those measures live in exactly one place. The copy that had been put inside the agent was taken back out the same day it was made: they are the client's own data, so they stay with the client and the portable agent carries none of them. One file to change, and nothing left to keep in sync.

One thing the work surfaced: the brand measures a channel that no agent has writing rules for. It is written down rather than left to chance — a request for it gets an honest answer instead of another platform's rules quietly reused.

Going stale is no longer discovered by accident. A change is refused unless its record moves too, the list of what to re-upload is posted where the change happens, and a daily note lands by email until it is done. The same files once sat out of date for thirteen days.

The rule travels past the one place it broke: the blank project form and the interview that fills it now offer “point at where your team already keeps these” as an answer, so the next brand cannot quietly re-create the copy just removed.

milestones.title: Put the whole copy craft into one portable agent — principles, workflow, the interview
Build the claims gate that fails closed, so unbacked copy can't ship
Write the market modules so copy is rebuilt, never translated, for each region
Set up the first brand as its own configuration, kept apart from the shared agent
Prove it end to end with a full dry run across every channel
Publish the agent so anyone can download and run it, with no private setup inside
Route campaign copy tasks to it in the shared workspace
Teach it to lead with strategy: question the brief, build the campaign idea, say what each version is betting on
Give it the writing rules for every channel it is asked for, so it never guesses a platform it doesn't know
Publish the upgraded agent so the downloadable version matches what it can do today
Confirm the channel KPIs the agent suggested, so its defaults stop standing in for the brand's
Make going stale impossible to miss — refuse the change, name the files, and keep saying so until it is done
Replace the five measures still marked provisional once the team sends the real ones
Write the missing channel rules for the one platform the brand measures but no agent can write for
